# dsh-composer-predictions
English · 中文

AI autocomplete and ghost-text suggestions for the composer in **DeepSeek
Harness desktop and the We

omplete and ghost-text suggestions for the composer in **DeepSeek
Harness desktop and the Web GUI**.
**Current release: latest on npm** · Install or update · 中文说明

- **Next message** — after the agent replies, the empty composer shows a
streamed suggestion for you

r likely next message. **Tab** accepts it as an
editable draft.
- **Inline continuation** — while yo

u pause mid-draft with the caret at the end,
the composer completes that sentence where the caret is

. **Tab** accepts the
completion without sending anything.

Up to three candidates are requested per call. **Alt+Down / Alt+Up** cycle them,
**Escape** dismisse

s the suggestions, and typing aborts any in-flight request
and hides the ghost. Streaming text is a

preview: `Tab` becomes available when
the final candidates are ready.

## How this differs from the other prediction plugins

This plugin combines next-message suggestions and draft continuation with
multiple ghost-text candid

ates and keyboard cycling: `Tab` accepts into
an editable draft, `Alt+Down`/`Alt+Up` cycle candidate

s, and nothing is ever sent
for you.
| | this plugin | dsh-composer-prediction | dsh-input-prediction | dsh-ghost-prompt |

| Suggests the next message after a reply | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| Completes the draft while you type, at

the caret | ✅ | — | ✅ | — |
| Several candidates per request | ✅ 3, inline | — | ✅ 1–3 chips | — |

| Cycle candidates without leaving the keyboard | ✅ `Alt+↓` / `Alt+↑` | — | — (click a chip) | — |
|
Accepts as an editable draft, never sends | ✅ | ✅ | Tab edits the draft; recommendation chips send

on click | ✅ |
| Streamed rendering | ✅ SSE (`/v2`) | not documented | ✅ | ✅ |
| Recent tool calls a

nd outcomes in the prompt | ✅ | — | — | — |
| Cache | ✅ per turn + per draft | ✅ | ✅ | not documente

d |
| Switch off in Settings, no uninstall | ✅ Settings → General | ✅ Settings section | not documen
ted | not documented |

"—" means the feature is not mentioned in that package's README as of
2026-10-25, not that it is imp

ossible. If all you want is an after-turn
suggestion, `dsh-composer-prediction` is a perfectly good,

more established
choice — this plugin is for people who also want the caret continuation and
keyboa
rd-only candidate switching.

**Settings → General → Composer predictions** switches both modes on or off.
The choice is saved in

the current browser or desktop window's local storage
on this device. Other browser origins and devi
ces keep their own preference.
## How it works

- The **Host half** registers two routes on the Harness web server:
- `POST /composer-prediction` —

JSON (`suggestion` plus `suggestions`), kept
for compatibility with older clients.
- `POST /composer

-prediction/v2` — Server-Sent Events: `meta`, `delta`
(streamed text), then `done` with the final ca

ndidate list.
- A request carries `{ sessionId, mode, draft }`, where `mode` is `next` or
`continue`

. The Host reads the Session tail (`deriveMessages()`), adds a short
list of recent tool calls and t

heir outcomes, and renders one bounded prompt.
`next` declines when the agent has not produced a rep

ly; `continue` includes
the draft text that ends at the caret.
- One small auxiliary model call runs

through `ctx.llm` over that prompt. The
suggestion uses the Session's own provider/model at the mod

el's lowest
reasoning effort unless `provider`/`model` are configured. Model output is
split into up

to `maxSuggestions` clean one-line candidates: numbering,
bullets and quotes are stripped, `NONE` p

roduces no suggestion, and drafts the
model restated are trimmed. A continuation keeps the model's l

eading
separator space; the Client adds one only when a non-CJK draft and
continuation would otherwi

se glue two words together.
- Completed results are cached per Session sequence (and per draft for
c

ontinuations), so a repeated request reuses the cached result. Simultaneous
requests from different

views have independent cancellation and may each call the model.
- The **Client half** registers int

o `conversation.input.overlay`, debounces
requests (600 ms after a turn settles, 500 ms after a typi

ng pause), aborts
superseded requests, and renders the ghost over the empty composer or at the
caret

. It measures the resident editor, so the ghost follows its padding,
line height, and scroll positio

n.
- Nothing is written to the Session log, and predictions are not counted as
conversation turns.
## Privacy and limits

- The conversation tail, recent tool activity and (in continuation mode) the
draft are sent to the c

onfigured model route, just like a normal turn.
Nothing else leaves the machine.
- Predictions are s

uggestions only; they never run tools or change the Session.
- Accepting a suggestion and then editi

ng it is a normal draft: it is only sent
when you submit it.
- Prediction calls consume model tokens

and may incur provider charges even
though they do not appear in the Session log or its token meter

.
- Only final candidates can be accepted. A disconnected stream is discarded.
- A continuation is h

idden when there is too little room after the caret; it
never shifts left over your draft.
- Final s

uggestions are announced through an accessible status message.
- Requires a compatible Harness build

with `conversation.input.overlay`,
`settings.general.item`, `connection.admit()`, `ctx.llm` and `se
ssion.deriveMessages()`.
